body:
# Better HUD – Enhance Your Minecraft UI

Upgrade your Minecraft experience with Better HUD, a resource pack that refreshes the game's interface for a cleaner, more modern look.

Features:

Better Hearts & Health Bar (See your health in a clearer, more stylish way.)

New Hotbar  (Sleek, easy-to-read item slots for smoother gameplay)

Updated Creative Inventory  (Makes browsing and managing items faster and visually appealing.)
